trend strong and seasonal strong, but ranking moderate – try a trimmed mean to reduce influence of outlier models.
The series has strong seasonality and a moderate ranking tau; a robust non‑linear combination like dba on a smaller, more stable pool could outperform the current trimmed mean.
Test a dba combination on the full pool to see if expanding the pool helps when ranking is moderate and weighted hint exists.
The series has moderate ranking stability and strong trend/seasonality; a robust non‑weighted median over a small, correlated‑error pool may outperform weighted combos.
try a weighted combination on the moderate‑ranking pool4 using inverse_error to see if a simple error‑based weighting beats the median pool4.
test a simple mean over all models
softmax may emphasize top models in pool4
The series has strong seasonality and a moderate ranking tau; a per‑horizon weighted approach on a stable subset may capture horizon‑specific strengths.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 10 backtested attempts, score 0.6238. Series context: trend strength 0.8181 and seasonal strength 0.8946; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.368); 7 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 6.025.
